fields.name: Eaton CF3000PRG (DF6000PR/FX6000PR) Addressable Passive Repeater Panel
fields.description:
The CF3000PRG is a cost-effective passive repeater panel designed to operate as either fully passive (display only) or semi-passive (restricted system control) through its programmable display. When connected in a loop, it shows system information text from the linked control panel and provides fire indications, including the panel number, for any connected network control panel that detects fire activation. The unit only requires local text programming for setup.


Equipped with a main menu-driven 2 x 40 backlit LCD display, the CF3000PRG clearly communicates system status information. It also includes six supervisory LEDs for quick visual reference, indicating power on, alarm, fault, supervisory mode, test in progress, and scroll functions, making it both functional and user-friendly for monitoring fire alarm systems.

fields.description:
The CAPT340 photo-thermal sensor offers rapid response to fast, clean-burning fires while retaining the optical sensor’s advantage in detecting smouldering fires. Its thermal enhancement allows a higher alarm threshold, reducing false alarms, and will trigger an alarm if temperatures exceed 60 °C.

This sensor features programmable day/night modes, set via the site installer software. In day mode, it relies on heat detection, ideal for areas with smoky environments during working hours. The unit is supplied with a back box and is surface-mounted.

The EC400 is a high-performance, reliable, and secure network infrastructure device for accessing Eaton’s Lon network of intelligent addressable control panels via intranet or Ethernet. Its built-in configuration server can manage up to 256 IP devices on a single IP channel without requiring a dedicated management PC. The unit supports DHCP, accommodating changing IP addresses in an intranet environment. Clear, diagnostic LEDs make installation and troubleshooting straightforward, without the need for expert knowledge or specialized tools. Connecting the Eaton Lon network over an intranet requires at least two EC400 units—one configured as a “configuration server” and the other as a “client.”
The EC400 when configured as a server requires the address list of all the EC400’s IP addresses in the network.
fields.features:
Uses existing infrastructure
Ideal for remote mounting when used with Eaton webserver software
Easy to configure

The EC541 is ideal for applications requiring Eaton’s fire system data to be transmitted over TCP/IP, while the EC542 LON Network Booster enables the interconnection of multiple channels and extends the overall network range.

fields.name: Eaton EC650B Addressable BACnet Gateway
fields.description: The BACnet Gateway (EC650B) is a CEA-709/BACnet interface that maps CEA-709 network variables (NVs) to standard BACnet server objects. When supplied as EC650B, it comes pre-loaded with LonWorks-to-BACnet address mapping, ready for integration with the Cooper intelligent addressable CF3000 system interface board. NVs are mapped to binary or intelligent addressable objects (inputs and outputs) in line with CEN/TS 15231:2005, with scalar NVs mapped to a single BACnet object and structured NVs mapped to multiple objects—one for each member, which can be individually selected. BMS systems can subscribe to and synchronize with BACnet server objects, which are updated automatically whenever a status change occurs anywhere in the fire system.
fields.features:
Fully compliant with ANSI/ASHRAE 135-2004 and ISO 16484-5
Maps network variables to BACnet server objects based on CEN/TS 15231:2005
Supports one BACnet MS/TP or BACnet/IP channel (configurable)

fields.name: Eaton CFSFL01 Addressable Single Mode Lon to Fibre Optic Adaptor
fields.description: The CFSFL01 Single Channel LON to Fibre Optic Adapter enables Eaton’s system network (LonWorks) devices to connect via optical fibre, supporting both point-to-point and multi-drop topologies. Using single-mode fibre optic, it can extend the Eaton system network up to 15 km with transmission speeds of 78 kbit/s or 1.25 Mbit/s. It connects via SC-type fibre optic connectors and offers significant advantages over conventional twisted pair cable, providing reliable, high-speed long-distance transmission even in challenging industrial environments with transients, surges, or electromagnetic interference—without the need for additional transient protection.
